info.title: CarsMultiverse recall record
info.description: Vehicle safety recalls from four national registers, and the cross-border matches between them on the manufacturer own campaign code. Free, no key, no rate limit. The filings belong to the regulators; the matching is ours and may be reused with attribution.

externalDocs.description: What the data is and what it cannot tell you

get.summary: Every recall we can prove appears in more than one national register, matched on the manufacturer own campaign code. The dataset nobody else publishes.
Transport Canada Vehicle Recalls Database as held here: counts, coverage dates, and how far through the file the reader has got.
EU Safety Gate weekly reports as read here: how many of them, how many alerts, and how much of the archive is still outstanding.
Every EU Safety Gate motor-vehicle alert held here, with its case number and a link to the Commission page for it.
The Canadian and American filing dates set against each other: who told drivers first, and by how long.
The same comparison for Europe and America.
The cross-border crosswalk as CSV, one row per recall.
